verdict: Qualified success for actual cooperative synthetic file/provider/journal handoff; not general retention-safe deployment.

executed.joined_handoff: Same journal-created file imported unchanged; actual full-history/shared heads block destruction; excision creates durable ticket; real provider unlink followed by SIGKILL leaves journal intent and stale manager state; checked retry and observed absence acknowledge; different-inode replacement rejected.
executed.immutable_history: Journal v2 independently validates prior creation/adoption/disposal observations and reserved/intent/acknowledged snapshots. Initial v1 mutable-history/orphan evidence remains preserved.

strongest_counterexamples: Swap saved plan after final validation: second retained resource outside authorized ticket is destroyed before final receipt failure.
Provider forced replacement deletes imported artifact before adoption-only Create fails.
Allowed file() expression changes an uncaptured dependency while gate check accepts.
Unexported resource created before after-state manifest validation rejects it; fake gate accepts empty census.

interface_limits: Existing gate rejects artifact provider; review uses explicit single-resource FileGate, not a false terraform_data identity bridge.
FileGate uses journal private verification inside an owned transaction; exact manager receipts remain sidecars rather than immutable journal observations.
Complete membership/dependencies, trusted excision authority, cooperative namespace and deployers remain assumed; modules and arbitrary HCL are unsupported.
next: Review v2 journal plus provider-aware admission. Test immutable execution bundles and provider-side durable retirement authority against plan substitution, forced replacement and effect/receipt crashes; version exact manager observations and restrict raw state exposure.
policy_alternatives: Coarse fence is demonstrated but blocks unrelated work; per-resource fences require membership/dependency/head conflict coverage.
Current per-head operational reacquisition checks versus explicitly authorized historical-inspection copying.
OpenTofu provider plus Delete authority versus simpler direct journal artifact effect.
boundaries: Synthetic local files only; no cloud/system/production operations, installs, commits, source edits to other workers, native DML changes, hostile-filesystem or distributed-protocol proof.
